6d66502ec4e40b1a02b150ae0c248e72c1347b0e.summary: CheckMAL, an anti-ransomware vendor (AppCheck), published a video page on WhiteBlackGroup Ransomware, which uses the .encrpt3d file extension. The page lists an MD5 hash, two antivirus detection names (GData and Microsoft), a file created at C:\ProgramData\CheckServiceD.exe, and offline encryption as a major characteristic. The distribution method is listed as unknown. Most of the page is product promotion. The page was archived on 2026-11-25.
